pages:
Northstar project briefing
Presenter: Mina Park
RAG means retrieval-augmented generation.
Northstar is a project name, not the star in the sky.

Request latency
Before: 240 milliseconds
After: 80 milliseconds
Availability target: 99.95 percent
This is a target, not a measured result.

Architecture
Gateway -> Retriever -> Document store
The document store is on the right.
Requests pass through the retriever before reaching the document store.

cases.review: Direction and milliseconds preserved, not seconds.
